content: Konili iso la pa Petrus be imar
Kar Sisarea na, tomtom ta imbotmbot, zaana Konili. Ni biibi ta kizin malmal kan ta timar pa toono Itali na. Imborro tomtom tomto lamata.

Mi ni Yuda som. Tamen ziŋan wal boozomen ta timbot ruumu kini na, timototo Anutu mi titoto mbulu kini, mi tigabgaaba zin Yuda pa suŋŋana kizin. Mi ni ikamam sorok koroŋ boozo pizin Yuda ta timbot ŋoobo i. Mi ni tomtom ki izuŋzuŋ pa Anutu totomen.
Aigule ta na, zoŋ mataana ikam kembei tel, mi ni ikeenetondo. Mi ire kat aŋela ki Anutu ta imar kini mi iboobi. Iso: “Konili o!”

Konili igeedi mi imoto. Imbot ma som mi iso: “Biibi, parei?” Mi aŋela iso pini. Iso: “Suŋŋana ku ramaki mbulu ku ambaiŋana ta uluulu zin sorrokŋan i, na Anutu ire kek. Mi mataana iŋgalŋgal mi leleene ambai pa kembei ta patoronŋana ambaiŋana.
Kar Yoppa na, tomtom ta imbotmbot, zaana Simon Petrus. Ŋgo wal pakan ma tila kini be tikami.
Imbotmbot ki Simon toro ta ikamam uraata pa buzur kulin na. Ruumu kini imbot ta tai a.”

Aŋela iso sua tana makiŋ, to izemi mi ila lene. To Konili iboobo mbesooŋo kini ru ta tikamam uraata pa ruumu kini na, mi tomtom kini malmal kana ta tau imbesmbeeze pini. Tomtom tana, ni tomini itoto mbulu ki Anutu.
Konili iso zin pa mbulu boozomen ta ipet na makiŋ, mana iŋgo zin ma tila pa kar Yoppa.
Petrus ikeenetondo
Aigule toro, zoŋ mataana ikam kembei palakuutu na, zin tel tana tiwwa ma tigarau kar Yoppa. Indeeŋe tana, Petrus isala pa pooto ta imbot ruumu uteene na be isuŋ.
Imbotmbot ma peteli, to iso ikan ka kini. Tikamam uraata pa ka kini, mi ni isu na ikeenetondo.
Mataana isala na, ire saamba ikaaga mi koroŋ kembei ta kawaala biibi i, timbuk tumbuntumbun paŋ, mi titu ma isu.
Mi buzur matakiŋa ta tisula kawaala tana. Kar kan, su kan, koroŋ karraŋan, mi zin man ta tirrie sala maŋaanaŋana na.
Molo som na, ileŋ sua ta kembei: “Petrus, maŋga, pun zin mi kan.”
Mi Petrus iso: “E-e Merere, irao aŋkan na som kat. Pa muŋgu muŋgu mi imar na, kwoŋ iteege koroŋ sa ta kembei pasa zen. Koroŋ pakan tina ambai pa kanŋana som. Pa tutu iŋgalsek pa.”
To ileŋ sua mini ma iwe ru pa. Iso: “Koroŋ ta Anutu itunu ikam ma iwe ŋgeezeŋana na, nu re kembei sananŋana pepe.”
Iso ta kembei pa tel, mi kawaala imiili ma isala mini pa saamba.
Petrus imaŋga ma ikamam ŋgar boozo pa koroŋ ta ire na, mi tomtom tel ta Konili iŋgo zin na, timar mi tindeeŋe Simon ruumu kini ma timender su kataama kwoono.
To tiwi ma tiso: “Simon ta zaana toro Petrus na, imbotmbot, som som?”
Petrus ikamam ŋgar pa koroŋ ta ire na, mi Bubuŋana iso pini. Iso: “Simon, tomtom tel tiru u a.
Maŋga ma sula re zin. Mi lelem iwe ru pepe. La gaaba zin ma niomŋan kala. Pa iŋga nio aŋgo zin ta timar na.”
Tana Petrus isula kizin to iso: “Nio ta ituŋ ti. Mi parei ta kamar kuru yo?”

To tiso: “Konili ta imborro zin malmal kan tomto lamata i, ni iŋgo yam ta amar i. Ni tomtom ndeeŋeŋana, mi imototo Anutu mi itoto mbulu kini. Tana Yuda ta boozomen timap tiwidit uruunu. Neeri ŋonoono, ni ikeenetondo mi ire aŋela potomŋana ta ipet kini. Mi iso pini be iboobu ma la ruumu kini, mi kam sua pakan pini ma ileŋ.”

Petrus imaŋga na ikam zin ma tilela pa ruumu tau ni imbotmbot pa i. Petrus ila ki Konili Tikeene ma aigule toro to, ziŋan Petrus timaŋga ma tila. Mi zin toŋmatiziŋ pakan ta ki kar Yoppa i tomini tigaaba zin.
Tiwwa ma tila ma aigule toro to tipet Sisarea. Mi Konili, ni iyogeege zin wal kini mi waene bizin pakan tomini, mi ziŋan tinamnaama zin ma timbotmbot.
Petrus ila mabe iloondo pa ruumu, mi Konili ila to itop su kumbuunu uunu bekena ipakuri.
Tamen Petrus ipeteke i ma iso: “Wa, kam kembena paso? Maŋga! Pa nio iŋgi tomtom raraate kembei ta nu na.” To iwiti ma imaŋga.
Ziru tizzo sua ma tilela na, Petrus mataana pokpok pizin iwal biibi ta tilup zin ma timbotmbot.

To iso pizin. Iso: “Ou, niom kuute lup kek. Niam Yuda, tutu tiam imender ta kembei. Zin wal ta Yuda somŋan i na, irao amgaaba zin som, amgarau zin som. Tamen Anutu, ni iso yo kek ta kembei: Irao aŋur ŋgalseki pa tomtom sa na som. Mi irao aŋso tomtom sa, ni sananŋana pa Anutu mataana na som.
Tana sua tiom ila, mi iŋgi aŋmar i. Aŋkam zooroŋana som. Lak, parei?”
Konili iso: “Wai! Mi nio ti, uriiza, zoŋ mataana ikam tel kembei ta buri na, aŋzuŋzuŋ su ruumu tio ti. Mi molo som na, aŋre tomtom ta. Mburu kini milmilŋana. Imar imender su kereŋ uunu mi iso:
‘Konili o, suŋŋana ku, Anutu ileŋ kek. Mi mbulu ku ambaiŋana ta uluulu zin sorrokŋan na, ni mataana iŋgalŋgal.
Tana ŋgo wal pakan ma tila kar Yoppa be tikam Simon ta zaana toro Petrus na. Imbotmbot ki Simon toro ta ikamam uraata pa buzur kulin na. Ruumu kini imbotmbot ta tai a.’

Tanata aŋgo zin tomtom ma tima ku karau men. Ma iŋgi mar ma ambai kat. Mi niam munŋoyam ta amar amlup yam su taiŋgi pa Anutu mataana. Tana sua ta munŋaana men tau Merere iur ma ku be kam piam na, so ma amleŋ.”
Zaala ikaaga pizin wal ta Yuda somŋan i
To Petrus imaŋga mi iso: “Oo, buri na, ŋgar tio ipet mi aŋkilaala i. Ŋonoono kat. Merere, ni iur leleene pizin wal pakan, mi wal pakan som na som.
Ni iur leleene pizin wal ta boozomen. Tana tomtom ta sombe imoto i, mi ikamam mbulu ta indeeŋe men pa ni mataana, na ta tina. Ni, Merere leleene pini.

Ŋonoono, uruunu ambaiŋana ta iso iti pa zaala tabe itiŋan Anutu taparlup ti ma tewe tamen pa i, na Anutu ipumuuŋgu piam Israel. Zaala tana imbot la uraata ki Yesu Krisi. Mi ni Merere kizin tomtom ta boozomen.

“Mi uraata biibi tau ipet ma irao lele pakaana ki Yudea na, niom ko keleŋ sa kek. Indeeŋe tau Yoan ikamam sua pizin tomtom pa yok kamŋana na, Yesu ki Nasaret, ni imaŋga pa uraata kini isu Galilea. Ni, Anutu iroogi mi iuri pa uraata kini. Pa isilou i pa Bubuŋana Potomŋana, mi ipomboli pa itunu mburaana. Tanata izzu ma izze pa uraata ambaimbaiŋan, mi iurpewe wal boozomen ta Tomtom Sanaana mburaana ikototo zin na. Pa ni, Anutu imbotmbot raami tau.
“Uraata kini boozomen ta ikamam su lele pakaana ki Yudea mi Yerusalem na, niam ti amre kat pa motoyam. Tanata ampombolmbol ka sua. Uraata kini tana, ta ikam ma tipuni ma imeete sala ke.
Tamen aigule iwe tel pa, to Anutu ipei i ma burup ma imaŋga mini pa naala, mi ipatooŋi pizin tomtom pakan ma tire kati.
Mi indeeŋe ta ni imaŋga pa naala na, ila ipet kizin iwal boozo som. Niam men ta ipet tiam mi amre i, mi niamŋan amkan kini. Pa Anutu ipeikat yam ta muŋgu kek be amender pa sua kini mi ampombol.
Mi ni itunu iur sua piam be amsoyaara sua pizin Israel ta kembei: Ni, Anutu iuri be itiiri zin tomtom pa mbulu kizin, mibe iur kadoono pizin. Zin ta matan yaryaaraŋan, mi wal meeteŋan tomini.
Mi Anutu kwoono bizin ta boozomen, sua kizin ipombol sua kini ma iso ta kembei: Wal boozomen ta so tiurla kini, inako ni iwe zaala pizin be Anutu ireege sanaana kizin.”
Anutu ikam Bubuŋana Potomŋana pizin wal ta Yuda somŋan i
Petrus izzo sua tana, mi Bubuŋana Potomŋana tau isu ma isalakaala wal ta boozomen ta tileŋleŋ sua i.

Zin Yuda pakan ta tiurla ki Krisi mi ziŋan Petrus timar na, tire Bubuŋana isalakaala zin wal tana, mi tileŋ zin tizzo karkari kalŋan mi tipakurkur Anutu, to timurur mi tisombe: “Wai, wal tiŋgi, zin Yuda som. Mi iŋgi Anutu ikam pizin ta kembei tomini?”
To Petrus isu mi iso: “Asiŋ irao iŋgalsek pizin wal ti be tikam yok? Som. Zin iŋgi tikam Bubuŋana Potomŋana raraate kembei ta iti.”
Tana Petrus iso pizin ma tikam yok pa Yesu Krisi zaana. Kaimer mana tibiigi Petrus ma ziŋan timbot pa aigule pakan.
